headline: Report Says CXMT Has Begun Small-Quantity HBM3E Production
deck: A report citing Reuters says CXMT has begun limited output and plans to expand HBM3E production in 2027.
body: Benzinga reported, citing Reuters, that ChangXin Memory Technologies has begun producing small quantities of HBM3E, an advanced high-bandwidth memory used in AI chipsets. [E2]
CXMT plans to expand HBM3E production in 2027, while Alibaba’s T-Head and Cambricon are testing the memory with their processors, Benzinga reported. [E3]

Reuters reported that CXMT plans to begin limited HBM3E production within roughly two months. The paper’s July 15 coverage examined HBM through SK Hynix; this report concerns CXMT’s reported production status. [E1]

The lead's claim (the research's own words): Reuters reported at 04:50 UTC / 05:50 Berlin that ChangXin Memory Technologies plans to begin limited HBM3E production within roughly two months even though only about 20%–30% of output is reportedly usable, versus roughly 70% at SK Hynix.
